sdk.errorMessage: This repository needs a .NET 10.0.x SDK, version 10.0.403 or later, so that self-contained builds bundle a .NET runtime no older than 10.0.14. .NET 11 SDKs and Linux distribution-packaged 10.0.1xx SDKs are not accepted. Install one from https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0 or with the dotnet-install script.
